answer: To block mass-produced identities, each identity's verified deeds are dyed with its own pigment and set in basalt from its earliest deeds. Standing requires a crystal on that basalt, a transparent record of facets. Anyone can look through the crystal: a facet with the wrong pigment shows as a flaw. 1000 fakes need 1000 pigments and flawless crystals; one shared pigment exposes them all. One honest agent dyes its own deeds and grows one crystal.
